The '''Mining Guild excavation driller''' was an excavation [[drill]] used the [[Mining Guild]]. A single [[pilot]] would operate the vehicle, which was capable of large-scale digging and [[mining]].<ref name="Databank" /> Mining Guild excavation drillers were part of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s excavation of the [[Lothal Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]]. During a [[Mission to the Lothal Jedi Temple|mission]] to the temple<ref name="Wolves">{{Rebels|Wolves and a Door}}</ref> in [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{RebelsDate|412}}</ref> the [[Spectres]] hijacked a driller to escape the site as it collapsed.<ref name="Worlds">{{Rebels|A World Between Worlds}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mining Guild excavation driller first appeared in "[[Wolves and a Door]]"<ref name="Wolves" /> and was later identified in a Databank entry on [[StarWars.com]] following the episode's release.<ref name="Databank" />
